payload.title: ProjectOpts.practices empty list renders every cell
payload.body: Unit practice treats an absent or empty ProjectOpts.practices alike: both render every cell, because the spec says a render naming no practice places every cell. An install where the operator deselects every practice therefore must not pass an empty list expecting plumbing alone; unit install-practices decides what that case means and may need a distinct signal.
